sql_original: SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1  INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event GROUP BY T1.event_id  HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 10 EXCEPT SELECT T1.event_name  FROM event AS T1  WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting'

question: List all the names of events that had an attendance of over 20 students but were not fundraisers.
sql_original: SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event GROUP BY T1.event_id HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 20 EXCEPT SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1  WHERE T1.type = 'Fundraiser'

SELECT DISTINCT E.`event_name`
FROM `Event` AS E
JOIN `Attendance` AS A ON E.`event_id` = A.`link_to_event`
WHERE E.`type` <> 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY E.`event_id`
HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;
